name: The Verge

sources.title: The Verge Contact — form with reason picker including 'editorial tip' and 'pitch a story'; tip fields: one-sentence summary, details, anonymity option

requirements: Not a directory — coverage is earned editorial; no listing product
The /contact page has a reason picker: editorial tip, pitch a story, technical support, advertising, press inquiry, security issue, moderators
The tip form asks for: one-sentence summary, detailed explanation, optional anonymity, name, email
A dedicated tip page exists at theverge.com/c/tech/22579076/how-to-tip-the-verge-email-signal-and-more (email + Signal options)
The Verge is part of Penske Media (PMX Global) — formerly Vox Media
preparation: A newsworthy consumer-tech hook — The Verge covers tech, AI, reviews, policy, entertainment, gadgets
One-sentence tip summary plus detailed explanation (the form requires both)
Name and email — anonymity is offered but they may need to contact you to verify
For a product launch, pitch a story with an embargoed press kit or review unit offer
workflow: Pick 'I have an editorial tip' for news tips or 'I want to pitch a story' for pitches
Fill the one-sentence summary, details, name, and email; check 'Keep me anonymous' only if needed
For sensitive material use the Signal/email options documented on the Tip Us page
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written article — no listing page is created
watchFor: Anything submitted may be published — the tip form is on the record
Form submissions agree to Vox Media community guidelines
A raw 'we launched' pitch with no news angle will likely be ignored — lead with what is newsworthy
Anonymous tips still require enough detail to verify
countsAsLive: A Verge article mentioning or profiling the product is published at theverge.com
unknowns: Response expectations or SLA on the pitch form — none stated
Whether freelance contributed pieces are accepted via 'pitch a story' vs staff-only coverage
